name: terrain-pulse
flavor_text: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.
effect_text_extend: If any terrain is active and the user is grounded, this moves power is doubled and changes type to match that terrains type.
effect_text_simple: If any terrain is active and the user is grounded, this moves power is doubled and changes type to match that terrains type.
